explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/753 (Erdős–Rubin–Taylor): is there c > 0 with χ_L(G) + χ_L(Gᶜ) > n^{1/2+c} for every n-vertex G? The answer is no, by Alon's (n log n)^{1/2} construction. listChromaticNumber is the sInf of k for which G is k-choosable, which is finite for finite G. The statement negates the existence of c over all G on Fin n, n > 0. Faithful.
